summary: Boundary County, ID lookout on Kaniksu NF land: 1937 tower and log cabin; tower removed or destroyed, log ground cabin remains in poor shape.

facts.design: Log ground cabin with a tower; sources disagree on the cab (L-6 per firelookout.com, L-4 per Idaho Fire Lookouts)
facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed; the log ground cabin remains in poor condition, with footings and debris from the tower on the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site a hike-in. No source says whether it is open to visitors today; the cabin is in poor condition.

events.note: L-6 tower with log cabin, per firelookout.com; Idaho Fire Lookouts describes an L-4 cab tower on a log ground cabin

corrections.why: The tower is gone, but the log ground cabin still stands in poor condition and footings and debris remain on the site. 'Ruins' means remains only, so the editor should confirm the label.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives an L-6 tower with a log cabin; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives an L-4 cab tower on a log ground cabin. The sources disagree and the story reports both.

A 2011 regional article still lists towers and log cabins on Cutoff Peak, while the later visit report and firelookout.com say the tower is gone and the cabin remains. The story notes that the 2011 article conflicts with the later visit report.

sources.title: Fire Lookouts of Boundary County, Idaho

notes_for_editor: Cab design disputed: firelookout.com L-6, Idaho Fire Lookouts L-4. The 1932 staff name predates the 1937 build date and no source explains the gap. Abandonment is dated only 'in the 1960s', so no abandoned event was written. The 2011 Naturally North Idaho article lists towers and log cabins on Cutoff Peak, which conflicts with the tower-gone record. The Idaho Fire Lookouts visit date is not given beyond the September 2, 2021 post date. Access level is unknown; only the hike-in label is sourced. Photo by Kyle Cossairt (firelookout.com) has no image URL, so no photo entry. Proposed correction: record status gone to ruins, for editor review.
